facts.label: Preposição + relativo
facts.sub: Formal e claro: the book on which the film was based; the author about whom there is a film. Na fala: the book the film was based on.

facts.label: Coisas
facts.sub: Use preposição + which para coisas: the book on which the film was based. Em português, “no qual”, “em que”. Sempre which, nunca that.

facts.label: Pessoas
facts.sub: Para pessoas, use preposição + whom: the author about whom there is a documentary; the director with whom I spoke. Soa formal e cuidado.

items.s: Preposition + which is correct for things.

The preposition can go at the end in informal speech.

pages.title: From book to film · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a wet afternoon in the centre of Cardiff. Hal and Zoe are standing in a bookshop. The smell of old paper fills the room. Hal holds a novel with a film poster on the cover. Zoe has seen the film but never read the book. They start to compare the two.

“Zoe, this is the book on which the film was based. I found it in the bookshop.” says Hal. “Hal, is it the novel in which the hero loses his memory? The plot is brilliant.” says Zoe. “Yes. The author, about whom there is a documentary, wrote it in a small town.” says Hal.
